QuestInfo.name: A Dark Place
QuestInfo.0: Just as you were about to grab the minion, you were whisked away to an unknown place.
QuestInfo.1:
You ended up all alone in some kind of void, but...
Is that Hawkeye's voice you hear?
QuestInfo.2: As soon as you heard Hawkeye's voice and returned to your senses, you were back to where you were before.

1.0: #h0#? Are ye okay? \r\n#L0##bHawkeye? Is that you? Something really strange just happened to me...#l\n#k
1.1: Ye were knocked out cold when I found ye here. Do ye remember anythin' at all?\r\n#L0##bThe Black Wings! They were here! When I reached out to grab one, I was... I was whisked away someplace!#l\n#k
1.2: Aye, that be a strange tale. Better let ol' Neinheart know about it. Ye go on back to Ereve. I'll look around here some more. Best not waste too much time. Neinheart ain't known for his patience.\r\n(You will be moved to Ereve after you accept.)

default.0: What is this place? How do I get out of here?
